rv.q: Theo Ubique brings a timeless classic new life with a wickedly funny cast.
Cheers to director Landree Fleming for tapping into her skill, creativity and comic instincts to make this production so fresh and wildly wonderful.

Landree Fleming, director of Theo Ubique's wildly fun and entertaining production of the already-campy Once Upon a Mattress , has found an answer: take the traditional musical and give it a most wonderfully nontraditional look.
Share in that joy as Theo Ubique presents Once Upon a Mattress, now through May 1.
A Mattress is a fun and light-hearted show filled to the brim with comedy and silly bits.
For most of us, the high production values and verve of the performers offer an inverting that’s also wonderfully diverting.
This is a lovely story about good triumphing over evil...
It’s incredibly funny to watch Dauntless stumble through his debilitating anxiety, and even more satisfying to see him power through it until it gives way to a lovely forthright sincerity.

cn.t: Theo Ubique's production of this fairy tale musical earns praise for its intimate staging, energetic performances, and fresh gender-fluid casting that modernizes the 1959 show while retaining its campy charm and heart.
